criteria.name: C_anchored_arm_consolidates_installed_competence
criteria.description: At least one anchored arm holds a strict majority of seeds at retained_fraction >= 0.5, beats the unconstrained arm's mean retained_fraction by >= 0.15, AND kept its plasticity (realised mean KL > 0.001 and trajectory peak >= 1.05x the install) -- so the retention is CONSOLIDATION and not FREEZING.

criteria.name: C_unconstrained_control_erodes_installed_competence
criteria.description: The unconstrained control does NOT hold the installed competence -- the contrast every anchored arm is read against. 780 measured 20.933 -> 11.667 here.

criteria.name: C_anchor_bound_dose_response
criteria.description: Realised mean KL to the frozen snapshot falls monotonically as kl_anchor_coef rises, with a spread > 0.0001. Measured WITHIN the anchored arms only: the control's guard value is a 0.0 sentinel, not a measured drift.

interpretation_grid.label: substrate_not_ready_requeue
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchor is sub-floor, OR post_bc_foraging_competence fails the 1.0 install floor on a strict majority of seeds in ANY arm
interpretation_grid.reading: There is no installed prior to retain, so the run is UNINFORMATIVE about retention. NEVER a retention verdict and never substrate_ceiling / substrate_conditional / does_not_support. Requeue.

interpretation_grid.label: retention_consolidation_protects_competence
interpretation_grid.condition: some anchored arm retains on a strict majority of seeds, beats the unconstrained arm by the declared margin, AND kept its plasticity (moved away from the snapshot and improved above the install)
interpretation_grid.reading: An UPDATE CONSTRAINT is sufficient to preserve an acquired policy: the consolidation/protection pathway MECH-457 posits is absent is constructible. Read the winning coefficient as a lower bound on the constraint strength required, not as a tuned optimum.

interpretation_grid.label: retention_by_policy_freezing
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchored arm retains on a strict majority of seeds but its realised mean KL is at or below 0.001 and its trajectory peak did not improve above the install
interpretation_grid.reading: A retention/plasticity TRADEOFF, NOT a consolidation success and NOT the null. Competence is preservable, but only by abolishing learning -- the anchor pinned the policy to its snapshot rather than protecting it while it refined. This is the trivially-retaining degenerate limit specific to an update constraint (the critic swap in V3-EXQ-788 has no analogue), which is why this branch exists here and not there. Re-pose at a weaker coefficient before reading any retention verdict from this arm.

interpretation_grid.label: retention_consolidation_succeeded_then_decayed
interpretation_grid.condition: an anchored arm's trajectory PEAK cleared the lift-competence target on a strict majority of seeds, but its terminal retained_fraction fell below the retention floor
interpretation_grid.reading: The manipulation SUCCEEDED and then DECAYED -- a retention-DYNAMICS finding, not a null. Read the trajectory and the half-life, not the terminal scalar. This is the branch V3-EXQ-780's grid lacked, which is why a manipulation that succeeded above target was scored a null there and self-routed bc_prior_not_the_axis (rejected on autopsy).

interpretation_grid.label: retention_eroded_under_all_anchors
interpretation_grid.condition: no anchored arm retains at any swept coefficient, and none shows the succeeded-then-decayed or frozen signature
interpretation_grid.reading: THE DECLARED NULL. Anchoring does not preserve competence -> retention is NOT a drift-protection problem. Removes H-retention-consolidation from the live set; does NOT weaken MECH-457 (diagnostic). Read jointly with H-retention-critic (V3-EXQ-788) and H-retention-auxiliary-decay (V3-EXQ-789) -- the null is only informative about the UPDATE-CONSTRAINT locus, and only across the swept coefficient range.

interpretation_grid.label: retention_grid_nondiscriminative
interpretation_grid.condition: no arm passed its precondition gate, OR the anchor never bound (realised KL shows no monotone dose-response across the swept coefficients), or the readouts fall in none of the enumerated branches
interpretation_grid.reading: Not a refutation. Unscored; re-pose the measurement. An absent dose-response specifically means the swept coefficients were all too weak to bind, which is an instrument-range finding rather than a retention finding.

anchor_dose_response.description: Realised mean KL to the frozen installed-policy snapshot, by anchor coefficient. Measured WITHIN the anchored arms ONLY: the unconstrained control constructs no PolicyKLAnchor, so its guard value is a hard-coded 0.0 sentinel rather than a measured drift, and comparing against it reads backwards. reuse_mint.note: The OFF arm (retcons_unconstrained) is emitted reuse-ELIGIBLE with the SHARED lineage slice (experiments/_lib/baselines/mech457_retention.off_path_config_slice) and include_driver_script_in_hash=False, so a sibling retention leg can reuse the minted cell across its different driver. NO reuse was attempted FROM V3-EXQ-788's mint, deliberately: 788 ran at substrate_hash 953cb8d0... and the enabling commit ree-v3 399b17caed edited three files under experiments/_lib/** (mech457_explorer_classes.py, mech457_bootstrap_explorer.py, baselines/mech457_retention.py), all inside the substrate glob, so the fingerprint CORRECTLY refuses that cell. A false MISS is the safe direction of the governing asymmetry. This mint is at the post-399b17caed substrate_hash and is reusable by V3-EXQ-789 if that leg runs on the same substrate.

kl_anchor_coef_scale_reference.note: The KL penalty enters the SAME policy loss as the entropy bonus, the only other distribution-level regulariser on the same logits, so the swept coefficients bracket the entropy-beta band and extend one step beyond it.

load_bearing_dv: The post-installation competence TRAJECTORY (not terminal competence) of a BC-installed raw_view policy across the reference RL refinement, probed every 250 episodes, under an UNCONSTRAINED update vs a policy KL anchor to the INSTALLED policy at coefficients [0.03, 0.1, 0.3]. Statistic: retained_fraction = terminal trajectory competence / installed (post-BC) competence, with the trajectory PEAK and the realised mean KL to the frozen snapshot read alongside it. PASS: some anchored arm holds retained_fraction >= 0.5 on a strict majority of seeds, beats the unconstrained arm's mean by >= 0.15, AND kept its plasticity (realised mean KL > 0.001 and peak >= 1.05x the install) -- so a frozen policy cannot pass by retaining trivially. Readiness: post_bc_foraging_competence clears the 1.0 install floor on the worst seed of every arm (780 measured 20.933 on raw_view, 3/3 taking); an install that did not take self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue.
